title: Vanilla Favorits Choripan
description: A compilation of my favorites mods, to improve the vanilla experience, especially created for potato PCs. Includes popular mods for builds, weapons, combat and animations. In addition to improvements for the end and the nether.
body:
A carefully curated compilation of mods designed to enhance the vanilla experience, optimized specifically for low-end PCs. It features popular mods for building, weapons, combat, and animations, along with complete overhauls for both The End and The Nether.

Includes:
-Yung's structures
-RPG series from ZsoltMoltnar
-Zombie awareness
-Sit
-Slap terrains
-Voice chanels and physics
-Dynamics ligths
-Better optimizations for client
-And more!
